snippet.title: Ormagi Press - announcement teaser
snippet.description:
«Your thoughts are untidy. We'll help you sort them out... and figure out what had really happened.»

Ormagi Press is now in development, coming to Windows and Linux! You can wishlist the game on Steam... starting today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1221670/
...more info on the game's web page. https://productions.polyvishap.com/projects/Ormagi_Press#:Welcome

----
...So, this thing started off as a different childhood pet project, I dunno if you can recall its tentative name or not, but... it's whatever. Don't matter much now. It feels really weird that I could have just given up on this thing entirely due to burnout and a PTSD-induced mental breakdown -- BUT! Somehow I ended up rebooting it into... this, but the difference is that I now know what I am supposed to be doing.
And, since it's been getting into a desirable shape, I can finally publicly yap about it now! Maybe I'll be doing devlog video series? I dunno yet, while I am aware making videos in general is a different timely endeavor on its own...

The game is gonna be in development for a long time, but I actually want to take it very slow, as I also may wanna do other things (and maybe release something smaller) in between, just so I don't explode and die going insane from working on the same thing all the time... but if you're fine with that - then feel free to stick around and watch this space! :D

~ Colbeala Moghes
